hooks.logic:
Queue the move {abilityTag: v, abilityOptions: {id: 2}}.
Let list3 be [[{messageSuffixNo: v2}]].
Queue the pose-change sequence list3.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

flow.text: Put queued moves ahead of counters.

hooks.logic:
Let v3 be the script register, then the battle settings of the enemy.
_ → each with (list, given (x) { Run helper on x. Let part be part x of the enemy. If condition flag data3 at x is up this frame and part is alive, then { If part has the NULL_PHYSICAL status, then part's 'statusAilments' → unset with (the NULL_PHYSICAL status). Otherwise, if util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry data2 at x in v3, then part gains the NULL_PHYSICAL status. } If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move. }, this state).

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let part be part arg of the enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases data at arg.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part, then
  Part changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  Part cancels its cast.

Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases data at arg.
paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part

helpers.logic:
For each x in list
  Set data3 at x to "physical_attack_" plus x.
  Append {conditionFlagTag: data3 at x, condition: {class: "DamageTransitConditionV2", args: {id: x, scope: "ANY", exercises: [game:Conf.EXERCISE_TYPE.PHYSICAL]}}} to list2.
